description: This file implements a microphone management class for handling speech recognition, including managing speech sessions, toggling microphone state, handling recognition events, and coordinating with a gateway for sending recognized speech. It provides functionalities for speech recognition, transcript processing, and voice conversation management within an Android app.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: Enum representing roles in a voice conversation, either 'User' or 'Assistant'.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: Data class storing individual voice conversation entries including id, role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: Main class managing microphone input, speech recognition sessions, handling recognition results, and coordinating conversation flow and gateway interaction.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the microphone, starting or stopping speech recognition accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses speech recognition for TTS playback, ensuring no recognition occurs during speech output.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes speech recognition after TTS playback finishes.

methods.name: onGatewayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in connection status to the gateway, affecting message sending and recognition operations.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from the gateway, particularly chat messages and recognition results.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates speech recognition session if conditions are met.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Configures and starts the Android speech recognizer.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of speech recognition after a specified delay.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Queues recognized speech text to the message queue and updates conversation history.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Schedules flushing of partial transcripts if there's a period of silence.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Updates the observable list of queued messages.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next message in queue if not already sending and conditions are appropriate.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for pending message send operations, reverting state if timeout occurs.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Marks the current message turn as complete, removing it from the queue.

methods.name: queuedWaitingStatus
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the queue status when waiting for the gateway.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the conversation with specified role and text.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates a specific conversation entry identified by id.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Creates or updates the assistant's message in the conversation.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Uses suspend function to synthesize assistant's reply speech asynchronously.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables the microphone and cleans up recognition resources.

methods.name: hasMicPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has microphone permission.

methods.name: parseAssistantText
methods.description: Extracts assistant message text from a JSON payload.
